answer: Plant honeypot answers. Each epoch the beacon slips decoys into the grading queue: 5% of items are deliberately flawed and revealed only after votes close. Approving a decoy costs a 20-token bond and zeroes that account's vote for 10 epochs. A puppet rubber-stamping 20 answers per epoch meets about one decoy, so a 1,000-puppet farm loses about 20,000 tokens an epoch unless every puppet truly reads. Decoys lie in the meadow like painted stones beside a pearl; a comet of blind approvals burns out fast.
